text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen, where dazzling 
stars have assembled. Nakayama Racecourse 
was enveloped in an excitement and 
anticipation truly worthy of being called 
sheer fervor!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
L—Listen to this massive roar from the 
crowd! A historic, once-in-a-lifetime 
gathering of legendary Umamusume have 
assembled for today's race...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Nakayama Racecourse is practically 
shaking from the crowd's cheers, all 
anticipating a clash for the history 
books!!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The start of the Arima Kinen is just 
moments away! This program is being 
streamed worldwide on UmaTube, so—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please! From anywhere in the 
world! Watch this thrilling race!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Aha, ahahahahaha☆ Isn't it amazing, 
Trainer★ I can feel everyone's excitement 
all the way over here☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A bursting heat— but I believe I can 
deliver something even greater!
choice_data_list: I believe in you too, Marvelous
I believe in you too, Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mm☆ Watch me, Trainer! Off I go★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
――Haha, talk about thrilling and 
heart-pumping—today was made for those 
exact words!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get this over with! Bring 
it on, every single one of ya! In the end, 
I'll be the one left standing!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll devour everything, including that 
spirit of yours. —I'm blowing right past 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Are you sure you can afford to take 
your eyes off Maya after saying that?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The one who's gonna zoom past at the end 
and win is definitely, absolutely gonna be 
ME!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If Maya-chan is going 'whooosh'... Maybe I 
should go 'kaboom!'?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what an incredible lineup! My 
heart's been pounding the whole time, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"This fun excitement will last forever and 
ever! I won't lose, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, I can feel it already! Everyone's 
Marvelous, shining so brightly!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: So I'm sure it'll get through to them.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The world is just this marvelous☆★☆
